nodes.name: Design Document
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Design Document" (specification, 162 lines): Implement the SCRUM-175 typed intake contract in place. Reuse the existing `intake_context` node family, its validator, and its regression tests instead of introducing a new family or a broader workflow surface.

nodes.name: Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Implementation Plan" (specification, 62 lines): Implement SCRUM-175 in dependency order while keeping the change inside the existing `intake_context` family and preserving the current G0-only boundary.
